levels.goal: 什么时候用一般现在：习惯、事实、时刻表，以及否定怎么加

rounds.tip: 频度副词放在动词前面
rounds.explain: 一般现在时表示「习惯做的事」。usually 这类频度副词（always / often / sometimes / never）要放在动词前面，不是后面。主语 She 是三单，动词用 walks。
rounds.example: She usually walks to school. / She always walks to school.
rounds.win: 频度副词站动词前面。

rounds.tip: 客观事实也用一般现在
rounds.explain: 一般现在时还用来讲「客观事实」—— 不管什么时候说都成立。主语 The earth 是单数，动词用 goes。
rounds.example: The earth goes around the sun. / The earth is round.
rounds.win: 永远成立的事，用一般现在。

rounds.tip: 否定要在动词前加 don't / doesn't
rounds.explain: 一般现在时的否定要在动词前加 don't 或 doesn't。主语 He 是第三人称单数，用 doesn't；而且那个 s 的活已经由 doesn't 干了，后面动词要还原成原形 like。
rounds.example: He doesn't like coffee. / He likes coffee.
rounds.win: doesn't 出现后，动词回到原形。

rounds.explain: 主语 My brother 是第三人称单数，否定要用 doesn't。don't 只能配 I / you / we / they。
rounds.example: My brother doesn't eat meat. / My brothers don't eat meat.
rounds.win: don't 和 doesn't，看主语是谁。

rounds.explain: 时刻表、班次这类「按计划会发生」的事，也用一般现在时，哪怕说的是将来的事。at noon 是时间点。
rounds.example: The train leaves at noon. / The train left at noon.
rounds.win: 计划好的时间表，用一般现在。

levels.goal: 过去发生的事：规则动词加 ed，不规则的只能记

rounds.explain: 一般过去时表示过去发生的事，动词用过去式。visit 是规则动词，直接加 ed。last week 是时间状语，告诉你这是过去。
rounds.example: I visited my grandma last week. / I visit my grandma every week.
rounds.win: 过去的事，动词加 ed。

rounds.explain: go 的过去式是 went，不是 goed。英语里最常用的动词几乎都是不规则的，只能一个个记。另外过去式不分人称，She 也用 went。
rounds.example: She went to Beijing yesterday. / She goes to Beijing every year.
rounds.win: 常用动词的过去式，得记住。

rounds.cn: 他们昨晚看了一部电影。
rounds.tip: saw 是过去式，seen 是过去分词
rounds.explain: see 的过去式是 saw。seen 是过去分词，它不能单独当谓语，得和 have / has / had 一起用（have seen）。
rounds.example: They saw a film last night. / They have seen that film.
rounds.win: 过去式和过去分词是两个东西。

rounds.tip: 改错：buy 的过去式不是 buyed
rounds.explain: buy 的过去式是 bought，不是加 ed 的 buyed。英语里没有 buyed 这个词。
rounds.example: He bought a new phone. / He buys a new phone every year.
rounds.win: 不规则动词不会乖乖加 ed。

rounds.cn: 你昨晚给我打电话了吗？
rounds.tip: 过去时的疑问句用 Did
rounds.explain: 一般过去时的疑问句用 Did 开头，后面的动词要还原成原形 call —— 过去时态的标志已经由 Did 承担了。
rounds.example: Did you call me last night? / You called me last night.
rounds.win: Did 出现后，动词回到原形。

levels.goal: will + 动词原形，will 后面永远不加 s、不加 ed

rounds.explain: 一般将来时：will + 动词原形。will 后面永远用原形，不加 s 也不加 ed。tomorrow 提示这是将来的事。
rounds.example: I will call you tomorrow. / I called you yesterday.
rounds.win: will 后面永远跟原形。

rounds.explain: will 已经把「将来」标出来了，动词就不用再变形。It will rains 是错的。
rounds.example: It will rain tomorrow. / It rains a lot here.
rounds.win: 一个句子里，时态标志只出现一次。

rounds.explain: 将来时的否定：在 will 后面加 not（口语常缩写成 won't），动词还是原形。
rounds.example: He will not come to the party. / He won't come to the party.
rounds.win: not 加在 will 后面。

rounds.tip: 改错：will 后面不能加 s
rounds.explain: will 后面必须用原形。不能因为主语是 She 就加 s，也不能用过去式 went。
rounds.example: She will go to London. / She goes to London every year.
rounds.win: will 一出现，动词就不变形。

rounds.tip: will 提到句首就是疑问句
rounds.explain: 将来时的疑问句把 will 提到句首，动词保持原形。
rounds.example: Will you help me? / You will help me.
rounds.win: will 提前，动词不变。

levels.goal: be + 动词 ing，表示此刻正在发生 —— be 动词不能丢

rounds.explain: 现在进行时：be + 动词 ing，表示此刻正在发生。be 动词不能丢 —— She reading 是残缺的句子。
rounds.example: She is reading a book. / She reads a book every night.
rounds.win: 进行时 = be + ing，两个都要。

rounds.explain: 主语 They 是复数，be 动词用 are。动词要变成 ing 形式 playing。
rounds.example: They are playing football. / He is playing football.
rounds.win: are + ing，主语复数。

rounds.explain: 主语 I 只能配 am。wait 后面跟人时要加 for，这是固定搭配。
rounds.example: I am waiting for you. / I wait for the bus every morning.
rounds.win: I 配 am；wait for 是一个整体。

rounds.tip: 改错：be 后面要用 ing 形式
rounds.explain: be 动词后面要用 ing 形式，不能直接跟原形。write 以不发音的 e 结尾，要去掉 e 再加 ing → writing。
rounds.example: He is writing a letter. / He writes letters every day.
rounds.win: 以 e 结尾的动词，去 e 加 ing。

rounds.tip: 进行时的否定：be + not + doing
rounds.explain: 进行时的否定：在 be 动词后面加 not，动词保持 ing 形式。不需要 do 或 does。
rounds.example: The baby is not crying. / The baby isn't crying.
rounds.win: 进行时的否定只动 be 动词。

levels.goal: was / were + doing：过去某个时刻正在发生的事

rounds.explain: 过去进行时：was / were + 动词 ing，表示过去某个时刻正在发生的事。主语 I 配 was。at that time 是那个时间点。
rounds.example: I was reading at that time. / I am reading now.
rounds.win: 过去进行 = was/were + ing。

rounds.explain: 主语 They 是复数，用 were。was 只给单数主语（I / he / she / it）。
rounds.example: They were waiting for the bus. / She was waiting for the bus.
rounds.win: 复数用 were，单数用 was。

rounds.tip: all morning 表示一整段时间
rounds.explain: all morning 表示「整个上午」，是一段持续的时间，正好配合进行时 —— 强调那段时间里一直在下。
rounds.example: It was raining all morning. / It rained last night.
rounds.win: 持续一段时间的事，用进行时更有画面。

rounds.explain: 主语 They 是复数，必须用 were。判断 was / were 只看主语是不是复数。
rounds.example: They were playing games. / He was playing games.
rounds.win: was / were 跟着主语走。

rounds.tip: 疑问词 + was/were + 主语 + doing
rounds.explain: 过去进行时的特殊疑问句：疑问词 + was / were + 主语 + doing。主语 you 配 were。
rounds.example: What were you doing? / What does he do?
rounds.win: 疑问词后面，助动词跟着主语走。

levels.goal: have / has + 过去分词：到现在为止已经完成，重点在结果

rounds.explain: 现在完成时：have / has + 过去分词。它说的是「到现在为止已经完成」，重点在结果，不在于过去的时间点 —— 所以不能说 I have finished my homework yesterday。
rounds.example: I have finished my homework. / I finished my homework yesterday.
rounds.win: 现在完成：结果和现在有关。

rounds.explain: for + 一段时间，表示这个动作持续了多久。主语 She 是第三人称单数，用 has。现在完成时也用来讲「从过去持续到现在」的事。
rounds.example: She has lived here for many years. / She lived here many years ago.
rounds.win: for + 一段时间，配现在完成。

rounds.tip: have been to 表示「去过」
rounds.explain: have been to 表示「去过某地」，是现在完成时的固定说法，说的是人生经验。ever 放在 have 和过去分词中间，表示「曾经」。
rounds.example: Have you ever been to Japan? / I went to Japan last year.
rounds.win: have been to = 去过。

rounds.tip: 改错：have 后面用过去分词，不是过去式
rounds.explain: have 后面必须用过去分词，不是过去式。see 的过去式是 saw，过去分词是 seen —— 这两个不能混。
rounds.example: I have seen that film. / I saw that film last week.
rounds.win: have + 过去分词，不是过去式。

rounds.tip: just 放在 have 和过去分词中间
rounds.explain: just 表示「刚刚」，位置在 have / has 和过去分词之间。leave 的过去分词是 left。
rounds.example: She has just left. / She left just now.
rounds.win: just 站在助动词和过去分词中间。

levels.goal: had + 过去分词：在过去某个时间点之前就已经完成

rounds.explain: 过去完成时：had + 过去分词。它表示「在过去某个时间点之前就已经完成」，所以句子里通常会有一个过去的参照点。already 放在 had 和过去分词中间。
rounds.example: The train had already left. / The train has already left.
rounds.win: 过去完成＝过去的过去。

rounds.cn: 她在晚饭前就完成了工作。
rounds.tip: before 提供了那个过去的参照点
rounds.explain: had + 过去分词，表示「在过去某件事之前就完成了」。before dinner 提供了那个过去的时间点。
rounds.example: She had finished the work before dinner. / She finished the work after dinner.
rounds.win: 两个过去动作，先发生的用过去完成。

rounds.tip: never 放在 had 和过去分词中间
rounds.explain: never 站在 had 和过去分词中间。see 的过去分词是 seen，不是 saw。句末的 before 表示「在那之前」。
rounds.example: I had never seen snow before. / I have never seen snow.
rounds.win: never 也站在助动词后面。

rounds.tip: 改错：had 后面用过去分词
rounds.explain: had 后面要用过去分词 gone，不是过去式 went。go 的三个形态是 go - went - gone。
rounds.example: He had gone home. / He went home.
rounds.win: go - went - gone，三个形态要分清。

rounds.explain: 过去完成时的疑问句把 had 提到句首。by then 表示「到那时为止」。
rounds.example: Had you finished by then? / You had finished by then.
rounds.win: had 提前，动词不变。

levels.goal: will have + 过去分词：到将来某个时间点之前会完成

rounds.cn: 我周五之前会写完报告。
rounds.explain: 将来完成时：will have + 过去分词，表示「到将来某个时间点之前会完成」。by Friday 就是那个时间点。
rounds.example: I will have finished the report by Friday. / I will finish the report tomorrow.
rounds.win: will have + 过去分词，三个词一起用。

rounds.cn: 到那时他们已经到达了。
rounds.explain: will have + 过去分词。by then 表示「到那时为止」，是将来完成时最常见的搭配。
rounds.example: They will have arrived by then. / They will arrive soon.
rounds.win: by + 时间点 = 到那时为止。

rounds.tip: forget 的过去分词是 forgotten
rounds.explain: forget 的三个形态是 forget - forgot - forgotten。have 后面要用过去分词 forgotten。
rounds.example: He will have forgotten my name. / He forgot my name.
rounds.win: 不规则动词的第三个形态，还是得记。

rounds.cn: 我们会完成这个项目的。
rounds.tip: 改错：will have 后面用过去分词
rounds.explain: will have 后面必须跟过去分词 finished，不能跟原形。这是三段式结构，缺一段都不行。
rounds.example: We will have finished the project. / We have finished the project.
rounds.win: will + have + 过去分词，一段都不能少。

rounds.explain: 将来完成时的疑问句把 will 提到句首，have + 过去分词原样跟着。
rounds.example: Will they have arrived by then? / They will have arrived by then.
rounds.win: will 提前，have + 过去分词不动。

levels.goal: be + 过去分词：主语从「做事的」变成「被做的」

rounds.cn: 这封信是 Tom 写的。
rounds.tip: be + 过去分词，执行者用 by
rounds.explain: 被动语态：be + 过去分词。主语是「被写」的那封信，动作的执行者用 by 引出来。write 的过去分词是 written，不是过去式 wrote。
rounds.example: The letter was written by Tom. / Tom wrote the letter.
rounds.win: 被动＝be + 过去分词。

rounds.tip: 说不出执行者时，by 可以不要
rounds.explain: speak 的过去分词是 spoken。这里没有 by，因为「谁说的」不重要 —— 被动语态常用于执行者不明确或不重要的时候。
rounds.example: English is spoken all over the world. / People speak English all over the world.
rounds.win: 执行者不重要时，by 可以省略。

rounds.cn: 这座桥是很多年前建的。
rounds.tip: build 的过去分词是 built
rounds.explain: build 的过去分词是 built（不是 builded）。被动语态里主语是「被建」的桥。many years ago 说明这是过去的事，所以用 was。
rounds.example: The bridge was built many years ago. / They built the bridge many years ago.
rounds.win: 被动语态的主语，是「被做」的那个。

rounds.tip: 改错：be 后面用过去分词
rounds.explain: be 后面要用过去分词 written，不是过去式 wrote。另外 by 后面要用宾格 her，不能用主格 she。
rounds.example: The song was written by her. / She wrote the song.
rounds.win: 被动里 by 后面用宾格。

rounds.explain: 主语 These cars 是复数，be 动词用 are。make 的过去分词是 made。
rounds.example: These cars are made in Japan. / This car is made in Japan.
rounds.win: 被动语态里，be 动词照样跟着主语变。

levels.goal: 八种时态加被动混着来 —— 限时挑战，看你能不能在 3 秒内认出时态

rounds.explain: now 提示「此刻正在」，用现在进行时 be + ing。
rounds.example: The baby is sleeping now. / The baby sleeps well.
rounds.win: 看到 now，先想进行时。

rounds.cn: 上周日我们参观了博物馆。
rounds.tip: last Sunday 提示用过去时
rounds.explain: last Sunday 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时，动词加 ed。
rounds.example: We visited the museum last Sunday. / We visit the museum every Sunday.
rounds.win: 有明确的过去时间，就用过去时。

rounds.cn: 这部电影我已经看过了。
rounds.explain: already 常和现在完成时搭配，位置在 have 和过去分词之间。have 后面用过去分词 seen。
rounds.example: I have already seen this film. / I saw this film last week.
rounds.win: already 站在助动词和过去分词中间。

rounds.explain: 被动语态 be + 过去分词。主语是「被写」的书。write 的过去分词是 written。
rounds.example: The book was written in English. / Someone wrote the book in English.
rounds.win: 主语被做，就用被动。

rounds.explain: by then 表示「到那时为止」，配将来完成时 will have + 过去分词。
rounds.example: I will have finished it by then. / I will finish it tomorrow.
rounds.win: by then 后面跟将来完成。

rounds.explain: have been to 是现在完成时的固定说法，说人生经验。ever 表示「曾经」，放在中间。
rounds.example: Have you ever been to Paris? / I went to Paris last year.
rounds.win: 问经验用 have been to。
